record: Rule-6 mutants for classifying the governing-intent amendment as a pending sibling of the block-provenance amendment, and for the declared identity x governing-intent exclusive pair (syzygy-34yu). Not authority.
method: Each mutant replaces every occurrence of `old` with `new` in one file of a fresh `git archive <commit>` extraction, then runs `command` from that extraction's root. Killed only when it replaced at least one occurrence, the command exits nonzero, and its output contains `expected`. M1 removes the governing-intent entry from the pending-sibling classification; M2 silences the unclassified-sibling finding; M3 skips every pending sibling in composition; M4 widens the exclusive pair to every pair of present siblings; M5 suppresses the regenerate-on-signing warning; M6 drops the malformed-pair finding.
finding: A first M2 (`if record is None:` -> `if False:`) crashed the selftest with a TypeError before any fixture ran; it exited nonzero but proved nothing about the fixture, so it was replaced by M2 above. Not covered by a killable mutant: the WARN print in main(). --check exits 0 by design whether or not the warning prints, so removing the print site survives every exit-code predicate; the warning text itself is pinned by the selftest (M5).

"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-34yu, each applied to a fresh `git archive` of
the whole tree at the given commit; the named command must fail with the
expected text."""
import json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

REPO = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
COMMIT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
POC = "scripts/build_three_surface_poc_block_provenance_amendment.py"
ENGINE = "scripts/build_pwb_anchor_resolution_amendment.py"
MUTANTS = [
    ("M1", POC, '        "three-surface-poc-governing-intent-amendment",\n    }),\n    #: The identity',
     '    }),\n    #: The identity',
     POC, "--check", "unclassified sibling package patches the spec: three-surface-poc-governing-intent-amendment"),
    ("M2", ENGINE, '            findings.append(f"unclassified sibling package patches the spec: {name}")\n',
     "            pass\n",
     POC, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAILED: removing pending sibling three-surface-poc-governing-intent-amendment"),
    ("M3", ENGINE, "    for name in sorted(pkg.pending_siblings):\n        sibling = siblings.get(name)",
     "    for name in []:\n        sibling = siblings.get(name)",
     POC, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAILED: a clashing sibling composed"),
    ("M4", ENGINE,
     "    pairs = [sorted(pair) for pair in sorted(pkg.exclusive_pending, key=sorted)\n"
     "             if len(pair) == 2 and pair <= set(present)]\n",
     "    pairs = [sorted(pair) for pair in itertools.combinations(present, 2)]\n",
     POC, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAILED: a third conflicting sibling passed beside a declared pair"),
    ("M5", ENGINE, "        if conflict:\n            warnings.append(",
     "        if False:\n            warnings.append(",
     POC, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAILED: a declared exclusive pair gave"),
    ("M6", ENGINE, "        if len(pair) != 2 or not pair <= pkg.pending_siblings\n    ]",
     "        if False\n    ]",
     POC, "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAILED: a declared pair naming no pending sibling"),
]
results = []
for mid, rel, old, new, script, flag, expect in MUTANTS:
    tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"34yu-{mid}-"))
    try:
        archive = subprocess.run(["git", "archive", COMMIT], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(tmp)], input=archive, check=True)
        target = tmp / rel
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        n = text.count(old)
        target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tmp / script), flag], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = run.stdout + run.stderr
        results.append({"id": mid, "file": rel, "old": old, "new": new, "occurrencesReplaced": n,
                        "command": f"python3 {script} {flag}", "expected": expect,
                        "exitCode": run.returncode,
                        "killed": n >= 1 and run.returncode != 0 and expect in out,
                        "outputMatch": next((l for l in out.splitlines() if expect in l), None)})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
print(json.dumps({"commit": COMMIT, "mutants": results,
                  "killed": sum(r["killed"] for r in results), "total": len(results)}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
